intro: Convert British stone (st) to pounds (lb) accurately for UK and Irish body-weight readings, medical records, fitness tracking, and boxing weight classes. Under the British Imperial standard, 1 stone equals exactly 14 avoirdupois pounds—simply multiply any st weight in stone by 14 to find total pounds. Check half-stone increments and common body weights from 1 st to 180 st in the reference chart below.

mistakesAndEdgeCases.title: Decimal Stone (10.5 st) vs. Stone and Pounds (10 st 5 lb)
items: Do not confuse decimal stone with stone-and-pounds notation: 10.5 stone equals 10 stone 7 pounds (147 lb), whereas 10 stone 5 pounds equals 145 lb (10 × 14 + 5).
When converting mixed readings such as 13 st 8 lb into pounds, multiply the stone value by 14 and add the extra pounds: (13 × 14) + 8 = 190 lb.

faqs.question: How many pounds are in 1 stone?
faqs.answer: There are exactly 14 avoirdupois pounds in 1 British stone (1 st = 14 lb). Conversely, 1 pound equals 1/14 stone (about 0.07143 st).

faqs.question: How do I convert stone and pounds to total pounds?
faqs.answer: Multiply the stone figure by 14 and add the remaining pounds. For example, 11 stone 4 lb equals (11 × 14) + 4 = 158 pounds.
